We have three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. I'd like each section to present their requirements so we can work through this at the coordination board and I can approve the final plan. Who wants to start?

The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is in the facilities binder, but it hasn't been added to the coordination-board slide yet. This means the facilities shop has a hard requirement on that first block.
